RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of discrimination is counterproductive and will likely harm your professional reputation. An all-female panel is not proof of bias. Public broadcasters often prioritize modern strategic needs, such as digital transformation, where the successful candidate's specific background may have aligned better with their future vision than sheer tenure. Two weeks is also a standard turnaround time for formal HR feedback. 

Instead of speculating on gender, follow up politely on your request for written feedback, focusing purely on your interview performance and skill areas to strengthen future applications.
